caption:
A long day in the field, and by Monday Toto feels every over.

Each role loads the body differently. Bowling works the lower back, trunk and hips hard. Keepers spend hours squatting, so hips, quads and calves get tired. Fielders throw and sprint, loading shoulders and hamstrings.

Lighter massage a day or two after the match tends to suit most players, with deeper work saved for midweek so your legs feel fresh by Saturday's first ball. Massage complements warm-ups, strength work and hydration in the heat. Sharp pain, swelling or a back that's worse each week is worth a physio assessment.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio tailor each session to your role on the field. Book online via the link in bio.
